authorship: Root module; imported DispatchMetadata authored by reviewer and independently root-reviewed.

validation.axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only; no warnings

findings: evaluated inducts on the exact eval equation and composes run_metadata for every actual continued step plus final terminal/EOF/failed/unsupported outcome. No payment, context, stack or success premise is added.
initialized specializes the same evaluated result to literal ChildMeter.init, deriving baseline=reservoir and committedSpill=0; these are conclusions, not incorporation gate assumptions.

failed_child requires actual caught classification and uses actual partial failedMeter, then derives all settled failure guards and incorporates after restore/forfeit. Parent execution is unchanged and reservoir increases by exact original child reservoir.

reverted_child requires same actual terminal and REVERT tag, retains output, restores actual meter, derives incorporation guards and returns unspent execution plus spill; no exceptional forfeit is applied.
The frame projection, actual output meter, settlement meter and incorporated child meter are the same expressions, not independently chosen witnesses.
open_boundaries: parentMeter, snapshot, incomingLogs and terminalWarm remain explicit interface values. Numeric incorporation does not identify actual source parent/child occurrence.
For REVERT receipt localWarm, supplied terminalWarm still needs binding to the same extracted prefix; the numerical meter equalities do not need that binding and do not prove it.
Source CALL/CREATE grants and initial frame/account/journal identity are not extracted merely by matching init execution/reservoir.
Uncaught faults and unsupported results are not settled by failed_child; global source/Python replay and canonical history remain open.
